exam_rules: Closed-book. Online proctored. No notes or reference materials.
id_requirements: Appian Academy account required. Government-issued photo ID for proctored exams.

lifecycle.summary: Confirmed current on the issuer host on 2026-09-19: Appian's certification catalogue offers 'two tracks - Developer and Analyst' with 'Exam Analyst Entry-level credential. No prerequisites.', and the Appian Certified Analyst page says 'This exam validates the knowledge and skills of individuals planning low-code applications and working alongside Appian developers.' with 'Exam Name: Appian Analyst Requirement(s): None Number of items: 50 Items Duration: 60 Minutes Price: $250 Minimum passing score: 70% Blueprint Updated: Last updated on January 2023'.

official_study_resources.notes: Free learning paths at Appian Academy aligned to certification exams
official_study_resources.title: Appian Academy

renewal_options: Certifications valid for 2 years. Renew by retaking the current version of the exam.

retake_policy.notes: 14-day waiting period. Full exam fee for retake.

testing_centers.notes: Online proctored through Appian Academy platform
